business_problem: The City of Madrid recognized the potential of generative AI to connect with visitors in an innovative way. It relied on iUrban‘s expertise and Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service to develop the VisitMadridGPT AI virtual assistant. The City decided on Azure because it wanted a platform that could easily support growth and interoperation with existing systems.
solution_summary: Madrid Destino / Madrid City Council built this solution on Azure OpenAI Service. The City of Madrid recognized the potential of generative AI to connect with visitors in an innovative way. It relied on iUrban‘s expertise and Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service to develop the VisitMadridGPT AI virtual assistant. Azure OpenAI Service provides the generative AI model layer used for summarization, drafting, classification, or copilots in the workflow. City of Madrid created VisitMadridGPT with Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service, offering tourists accurate, real-time info and personalized responses in 95-plus languages. It also helps the City analyze conversations to better understand tourist needs. Messages, calls, or requests enter the existing workflow, Azure OpenAI Service classifies or summarizes them, and the reviewed output is surfaced to agents and frontline staff.
